Class PottsModuleFlyGMCDifferentiation

All Implemented Interfaces:
Module
public class PottsModuleFlyGMCDifferentiation extends PottsModuleProliferationVolumeBasedDivision
Implementation of PottsModuleProliferationVolumeBasedDivision for fly GMC agents. These cells divide into two PottsCellFlyNeuron cells. The links must be set in the setup file so that 100% of the daughter cells are Neurons.

  • Method Details

    • addCell

      void addCell(ec.util.MersenneTwisterFast random, Simulation sim)
      Adds a cell to the simulation.

      The cell location is split. The new neuron cell is created, initialized, and added to the schedule. This cell's location is also assigned to a new Neuron cell.

      Specified by:
